name: get-wechat-history
description: Read, search, and export fresh local WeChat history through a read-only MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Initializes and diagnoses the local WeChat history reader, then reads recent messages or a specified person or group, exports complete chat history, and decodes requested image messages.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare the local history reader when needed, then read the WeChat history I ask for and use only the minimum messages needed for my request.
